board.name: Wyoming Board of Medicine (with a physician assistant advisory council)

cycleYears.reason: 60 hours during the preceding three calendar years, checked at each annual renewal

certificationInLieu.note: Exempt if certified or recertified by NCCPA within the three years before the renewal date.

window.reason: The 60 hours count over the three calendar years before the year of each annual renewal.

exemption.field: Held a Wyoming PA license less than three years
exemption.question: Have you held your Wyoming PA license for less than three years as of this renewal?
exemption.text: A PA who has held a Wyoming license less than three years is exempt from the 60 hours.

topics.label: Responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders, every two years

condition.field: Holds a state controlled substance registration
condition.question: Do you hold a Wyoming Board of Pharmacy controlled substance registration?
condition.description: Applies to holders of the state controlled substance registration.

agreement.text: No supervision or collaboration agreement is filed for a PA who passed the NCCPA exam; the degree of collaboration is set at the practice level. A temporary licensee who has not yet passed the exam keeps a board approved supervision plan on file.

options.text: Hold an active Wyoming APRN license: meet the APRN competency requirement instead
400 hours of active nursing practice in the past two years

unverified: The NCLEX, refresher course and nursing degree competency options

ce.reason: APRN competency at renewal is current national certification in the role and population focus plus the controlled substance hours.

notes.text: APRNs recognized before January 1, 1999 without national certification instead submit 40 CE hours and 400 APRN practice hours in the last two years.

topics.label: Responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders, each renewal
